_comment: Rolling pricing table consumed by loki-ts/src/runner/budget.ts. Update this file when Anthropic / OpenAI / others publish new prices; no code change required. Pricing is USD per 1 million tokens. Aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) point to the latest model of that family per providers/model_catalog.json.
_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing 301-redirects there), read 2026-10-08. Per MTok. fable=Claude Fable 5.1 $10/$50, cache read $0.25 (0.025x), 5m write $12.50, 1h write $20. opus=Claude Opus 5.5 $4/$20, cache read $0.20 (0.05x), 5m write $5, 1h write $8. sonnet=Claude Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, cache read $0.10 (0.05x), 5m write $2.50, 1h write $4. haiku alias row stays Haiku 4.5 $1/$5, read $0.10, 5m $1.25, 1h $2. claude-haiku-5-5 (exact id): $0.10/$0.50, read $0.01, 5m $0.125, 1h $0.20 up to 100,000 prompt tokens; over_100k $0.50/$2.50, read $0.05, 5m $0.625, 1h $1. Fields: cache_write is the 5m write rate (legacy readers); cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the explicit tiers. Multipliers: 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2x, read 0.1x (0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, 0.025x on Fable 5.1). codex rows: gpt-5.3-codex standard tier.
